decisions.reason: The IMU module sits close to the core building-block system, design and inventory are already sunk, and its promotion to a page of its own in 2024 signals growing commitment.
The industrial AC input module was publicly announced as a launch and has had its own page in both years, so visible commitment and its fit with the industrial direction favour persistence.
Although it is only mentioned rather than featured, the solid state relay module is a low-cost extension of the modular platform, and any weak results can be blamed on temporary market conditions.
Launched only in 2024 and built on the established brick and bricklet architecture, the RGB LED module has not yet had time to prove itself, which justifies continued commitment.
The wallbox remote access service is central to the announced expansion of charging and energy management, so dropping it would contradict the firm's stated strategic direction.
